'''Michèle Rivasi''' (9 February 1953 – 29 November 2023) was a French politician who served as a [[member of the European Parliament]] (MEP) from 2009 until her death in 2023, for [[Europe Écologie–The Greens]]. She was previously a [[member of the French National Assembly]] and before that, a teacher. An environmentalist active since the [[Chernobyl disaster]] in 1986, she was also a leader of [[Greenpeace]] in France.

==Early life==
Born on 9 February 1953, in [[Montélimar]], [[Drôme]], in southeastern France.<ref name=eura>{{cite web|url=http://www.europarl.europa.eu/members/expert/alphaOrder/view.do?language=EN&id=96743|title=Your MEPs : Michèle RIVASI|work=[[Europa (web portal)|Europa]]|publisher=[[European Parliament]]|access-date=5 April 2011|archive-date=17 March 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110317105536/http://www.europarl.europa.eu/members/expert/alphaOrder/view.do?language=EN&id=96743|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="Assembly" /> She was an alumna of the ''[[École Normale Supérieure de Fontenay-aux-Roses|École normale supérieure de Fontenay-aux-Roses]]'' and taught biology<ref>Carmen Paun (15 January 2018), [https://www.politico.eu/article/the-greens-vaccine-critic-radical/ Europe's green brawler] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191003084740/https://www.politico.eu/article/the-greens-vaccine-critic-radical/ |date=3 October 2019 }} ''[[Politico Europe]]''</ref> at [[Institut Universitaire de Formation des Maîtres]]<ref name="eura" /><ref name="Assembly" /> before entering politics.

==Political career==
===Career in national politics===
In 1986 Rivasi founded the [[Commission for Independent Research and Information on Radioactivity]] following the [[Chernobyl disaster]].<ref>{{cite news |last= |first= |date=29 November 2023|title=Décès de Michèle Rivasi|trans-title= |url=https://www.criirad.org/29-11-2023-deces-de-michele-rivasi/|language=French|work=[[Commission for Independent Research and Information on Radioactivity]]|location= |access-date=30 November 2023}}</ref>

From [[1997 French legislative election|1997]] until [[2002 French legislative election|2002]], Rivasi was a member of the [[National Assembly (France)|National Assembly]], representing the [[Drôme's 1st constituency]] ([[Valence, Drôme|Valence]]).<ref name="Assembly">[https://www2.assemblee-nationale.fr/deputes/fiche/OMC_PA2576 Michèle Rivasi] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200811194759/http://www2.assemblee-nationale.fr/deputes/fiche/OMC_PA2576 |date=11 August 2020 }} [[National Assembly (France)|National Assembly]].</ref> In parliament, she served on the Defence Committee.<ref name="Assembly"/> She was classified as an independent [[ecologist]] close to the [[Socialist Party (France)|PS]], but later joined [[Europe Écologie–The Greens]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ecolopedia.fr/?p=3342|title=Michèle Rivasi|work=Ecolopedia|date=22 August 2016 |language=French|access-date=30 November 2023|archive-date=13 August 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220813220709/http://www.ecolopedia.fr/?p=3342|url-status=live}}</ref>

From September 2003 to November 2004, Rivasi was the director of [[Greenpeace]] in France.<ref>{{cite news|last=Dodet|first=Remy|date=2 November 2016|title=EELV. Rivasi contre Jadot : ils ont le même programme... mais ne s'aiment guère|trans-title=|url=https://www.nouvelobs.com/politique/election-presidentielle-2017/20161102.OBS0602/eelv-rivasi-contre-jadot-ils-ont-le-meme-programme-mais-ne-s-aiment-guere.html|language=French|work=[[L'Obs]]|location=|access-date=30 November 2023|archive-date=26 May 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230526081933/https://www.nouvelobs.com/politique/election-presidentielle-2017/20161102.OBS0602/eelv-rivasi-contre-jadot-ils-ont-le-meme-programme-mais-ne-s-aiment-guere.html|url-status=live}}</ref>

===Member of the European Parliament, 2009–2023===
In 2009, [[The Greens (France)|The Greens]] selected Rivasi to lead the [[Europe Écologie]] list in the [[South-East France (European Parliament constituency)|South-East]] constituency ahead of the [[2009 European Parliament election in France|2009 European elections]], in addition to which she was an assistant to the Mayor of [[Valence, Drôme|Valence]], and a member of the General Council of the Drôme.<ref>{{cite news|last=|first=|date=29 January 2020|title=Valence : Michèle Rivasi soutient "Avec" mais ne figurera pas sur la liste|trans-title=|url=https://www.ledauphine.com/politique/2020/01/28/valence-michele-rivasi-soutient-avec-mais-ne-figurera-pas-sur-la-liste|language=French|work=[[Le Dauphiné libéré]]|location=Drôme|access-date=30 November 2023|archive-date=2 November 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231102195635/https://www.ledauphine.com/politique/2020/01/28/valence-michele-rivasi-soutient-avec-mais-ne-figurera-pas-sur-la-liste|url-status=live}}</ref>

In parliament, Rivasi served on the [[Committee on Industry, Research and Energy]] (2009–2014), the [[European Parliament Committee on the Environment, Public Health and Food Safety|Committee on the Environment, Public Health and Food Safety]] (2014–2019) and the Special Committee on the European Union's authorisation procedure for pesticides (2018).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.europarl.europa.eu/meps/en/96743/MICHELE_RIVASI/history/8|title=Michèle Rivasi|work=European Parliament|date=9 February 1953 |access-date=30 November 2023|archive-date=16 June 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230616114745/https://www.europarl.europa.eu/meps/en/96743/MICHELE_RIVASI/history/8|url-status=live}}</ref> After the [[2019 European election|2019 elections]], she served on the [[Committee on Development]] and the [[Committee on Budgetary Control]].<ref name="Euro">[http://www.europarl.europa.eu/meps/en/96743/MICHELE_RIVASI/home Michèle Rivasi] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191005000818/http://www.europarl.europa.eu/meps/en/96743/MICHELE_RIVASI/home |date=5 October 2019 }} [[European Parliament]].</ref> From 2010 until 2011, she notably served as the Parliament's [[rapporteur]] on measures to co-ordinate the European response to health crises such as the [[2009 flu pandemic]].<ref>Peter O'Donnell (7 July 2010), [https://www.politico.eu/article/ministers-admit-flu-errors/ Ministers admit flu errors] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191003084812/https://www.politico.eu/article/ministers-admit-flu-errors/ |date=3 October 2019 }} ''[[European Voice]]''.</ref><ref>Dave Keating (7 December 2011), [https://www.politico.eu/article/commission-seeks-powers-to-lead-eu-health-crises-response/ Commission seeks powers to lead EU health-crises response] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191003084731/https://www.politico.eu/article/commission-seeks-powers-to-lead-eu-health-crises-response/ |date=3 October 2019 }} ''[[European Voice]]''.</ref> In 2020, she also joined the Special Committee on Beating Cancer.<ref>[https://www.europarl.europa.eu/sed/doc/news/flash/24221/Full%20Members%20new%20committees_09-07-2020_en.pdf Members of the Special Committee on Beating Cancer] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211112124345/https://www.europarl.europa.eu/sed/doc/news/flash/24221/Full%20Members%20new%20committees_09-07-2020_en.pdf |date=12 November 2021 }} [[European Parliament]], press release of 9 July 2020.</ref> From 2021 onwards, she was part of the Parliament's delegation to the [[Conference on the Future of Europe]].<ref>[https://conference-delegation.europarl.europa.eu/en/members.html Members of the delegation to the Conference on the Future of Europe] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210610155650/https://conference-delegation.europarl.europa.eu/en/members.html |date=10 June 2021 }} [[European Parliament]].</ref>

Following the [[2019 European Parliament election|2019 elections]], Rivasi was part of a cross-party working group in charge of drafting the European Parliament's four-year work program on digitization.<ref>Florian Eder (13 June 2019), [https://www.politico.eu/newsletter/brussels-playbook/politico-brussels-playbook-presented-by-google-madrids-moment-parliament-working-groups-sneak-peak-happy-birthday-gdpr/ POLITICO Brussels Playbook, presented by Google: Madrid's moment — Parliament working groups sneak peak — Happy birthday, GDPR] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210301113616/https://www.politico.eu/newsletter/brussels-playbook/politico-brussels-playbook-presented-by-google-madrids-moment-parliament-working-groups-sneak-peak-happy-birthday-gdpr/ |date=1 March 2021 }} ''[[Politico Europe]]''.</ref>

In addition to her committee assignments, Rivasi was also part of the Parliament's delegation to the [[ACP–EU Joint Parliamentary Assembly]] beginning in 2009.<ref name="Euro"/> She was also a member of the European Parliament Intergroup on the Welfare and Conservation of Animals<ref>[http://www.animalwelfareintergroup.eu/about-us/members/ Members] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190831215301/http://www.animalwelfareintergroup.eu/about-us/members/ |date=31 August 2019 }} European Parliament Intergroup on the Welfare and Conservation of Animals.</ref>

Ahead of the [[2017 French presidential election]], Rivasi ran for her party's nomination for the presidency but eventually lost in the final round of the primaries against [[Yannick Jadot]].<ref>{{cite news|author=Sébastien Tronche|title=Yannick Jadot élu candidat d'EELV face à Michèle Rivasi pour la présidentielle de 2017|url=http://lelab.europe1.fr/yannick-jadot-elu-candidat-deelv-face-a-michele-rivasi-pour-la-presidentielle-de-2017-2893619|work=Le Lab|publisher=Europe 1|date=7 November 2016|access-date=24 February 2017|url-status = live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170225130301/http://lelab.europe1.fr/yannick-jadot-elu-candidat-deelv-face-a-michele-rivasi-pour-la-presidentielle-de-2017-2893619|archive-date=25 February 2017}}</ref><ref>Quentin Ariès (7 November 2016), [https://www.politico.eu/article/french-greens-yannick-jadot-mep-for-2017-presidential-race/ French Greens pick MEP Jadot for 2017 presidential race] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191003084746/https://www.politico.eu/article/french-greens-yannick-jadot-mep-for-2017-presidential-race/ |date=3 October 2019 }} ''[[Politico Europe]]''.</ref>

In February 2019, Rivasi was one of four Green MEPs (the others being [[Molly Scott Cato]], [[Tilly Metz]], and Thomas Waitz) who were temporarily arrested after breaking into the [[Kleine Brogel Air Base]] to protest against the presence of U.S. [[B61 nuclear bomb]]s on European soil; the protest followed the U.S. withdrawal from the [[Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty|Intermediate-range Nuclear Forces]] (INF) Treaty earlier that month.<ref>Eline Schaart (20 February 2019), [https://www.politico.eu/article/four-green-meps-arrested-after-anti-nuclear-protest-at-belgian-military-base/ 4 Green MEPs arrested after anti-nuclear protest at Belgian military base] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191003084729/https://www.politico.eu/article/four-green-meps-arrested-after-anti-nuclear-protest-at-belgian-military-base/ |date=3 October 2019 }} ''[[Politico Europe]]''.</ref>

==Political positions==
Rivasi described herself as "vaccination skeptic".<ref>[http://www.michele-rivasi.eu/medias/vaccins-de-la-necessite-de-debattre-pour-restaurer-la-confiance-stop-aux-proces-en-sorcellerie/ Rivasi's blog] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180504225908/http://www.michele-rivasi.eu/medias/vaccins-de-la-necessite-de-debattre-pour-restaurer-la-confiance-stop-aux-proces-en-sorcellerie/ |date=4 May 2018 }}.</ref> She sparked controversy in July 2021 after comparing the extension of the health pass obligation announced by President Macron with apartheid and many left-wing officials, including from the Greens, expressed their indignation and criticised her.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://bbc-edition.com/space/2021/07/13/comments-by-green-mep-michele-rivasi-about-the-health-pass-are-controversial-on-the-left/ |title=BBC |access-date=16 July 2021 |archive-date=16 July 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210716134609/https://bbc-edition.com/space/2021/07/13/comments-by-green-mep-michele-rivasi-about-the-health-pass-are-controversial-on-the-left/ |url-status=live }}</ref> On two occasions in 2021, she made a communication to the so-called ″conseil scientifique indépendant″ (Independent scientific council) of the highly controversial RéinfoCovid website that propagates COVID-19 vaccine misinformation.<ref>Vincent Coquaz [https://www.liberation.fr/checknews/quest-ce-que-le-conseil-scientifique-independant-qui-a-invite-michele-rivasi-a-une-reunion-publique-20210427_POUCZVBEC5B3LJJN6QRNIZSW6U ''Libération''] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211201160931/https://www.liberation.fr/checknews/quest-ce-que-le-conseil-scientifique-independant-qui-a-invite-michele-rivasi-a-une-reunion-publique-20210427_POUCZVBEC5B3LJJN6QRNIZSW6U/ |date=1 December 2021 }}, 27 April 2021.</ref>

Rivasi was a strong supporter of [[alternative medicine]] and [[homeopathy]].<ref>[https://reporterre.net/L-offensive-contre-l-homeopathie-veut-eradiquer-une-pensee-medicale-alternative ''Reporterre''] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190629143046/https://reporterre.net/L-offensive-contre-l-homeopathie-veut-eradiquer-une-pensee-medicale-alternative |date=29 June 2019 }}, June 2019</ref>

She opposed the planned Midi-Catalonia ([[Enagás#MidCat pipeline project|Midcat]]) pipeline that would more than double the amount of gas that can be piped across the Pyrenees mountains that border Spain and France.<ref>Geert De Clercq (17 April 2018), [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-spain-gas-exclusive/exclusive-viability-of-french-spain-gas-pipeline-questioned-report-idUSKBN1HO34R Exclusive: Viability of French-Spain gas pipeline questioned – report] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191003093222/https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-spain-gas-exclusive/exclusive-viability-of-french-spain-gas-pipeline-questioned-report-idUSKBN1HO34R |date=3 October 2019 }} ''[[Reuters]]''.</ref>

==Death==
Rivasi died from a heart attack in [[Brussels]] on 29 November 2023, at age 70, while on the way to the Parliament.<ref>{{cite news |title=Décès de Michèle Rivasi : les réactions politiques à la mort de l'eurodéputée drômoise |url=https://www.francebleu.fr/infos/politique/deces-de-michele-rivasi-les-reactions-politiques-a-la-mort-de-l-eurodeputee-dromoise-1325281 |access-date=29 November 2023 |publisher=ici |date=29 November 2023 |archive-date=29 November 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231129151959/https://www.francebleu.fr/infos/politique/deces-de-michele-rivasi-les-reactions-politiques-a-la-mort-de-l-eurodeputee-dromoise-1325281 |url-status=live }}</ref>
